name: Mingyue Optical Lens Co.,Ltd.
summary: Mingyue Optical Lens Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, and production of lenses, lens raw materials, finished mirrors, and frames in China and internationally. The company offers myopia management for teenagers, progressive multifocal lenses, photochromic lenses, custom lenses, anti-fatigue lenses, outdoor polarized myopia sunglasses, KR lenses, post-operative protection lenses, and other product series. It also engages in wholesale and retail trade; and technology promotion and application service industry. Mingyue Optical Lens Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is based in Danyang, China.
